summary: Static site built with Astro and served free from Cloudflare Pages; no backend or database to run.

architecture_rationale.text: No server-side needs (no accounts, payments or user data), so pre-built pages on a CDN: nothing to run or patch. Microservices rejected: 2 engineer(s) cannot absorb their operational overhead.

frontend.justification: Pre-renders pages to static HTML with zero JS by default. Fit for this project: team.languages includes JavaScript; well suited to content site projects; strong cost, which you rated 5/5; seo_critical=true and it serves pre-rendered HTML.

alternatives.why_not: Lower overall fit: the chosen option wins on project.type (well suited to content site projects).

tradeoffs: Rich app-like interactivity needs islands; large SPAs are a poor fit.

backend.justification: The site has no server-side logic. Fit for this project: static content needs no server: nothing to run, patch or pay for; strong cost, which you rated 5/5; strong time to market, which you rated 4/5.

alternatives.why_not: Lower overall fit: a server is unnecessary for a static content site; the chosen option wins on project.type (static content needs no server: nothing to run, patch or pay for).

database.justification: Content lives in the repository as Markdown files. Fit for this project: content is Markdown in the repository; no database to run; strong cost, which you rated 5/5; strong time to market, which you rated 4/5.

alternatives.why_not: Lower overall fit: a database is unnecessary for static content; the chosen option wins on project.type (content is Markdown in the repository; no database to run).

hosting.justification: Free global CDN with unlimited static bandwidth on the free plan. Fit for this project: strong cost, which you rated 5/5; well suited to content site projects; strong time to market, which you rated 4/5; serves pre-built static files from a CDN.

alternatives.why_not: Close runner-up: it fits the rest of the stack less well.
